notes: Deceit is the undead dungeon of bones, chains and gibbets. The easy pieces are bones and a small web, the hard pieces are hung prisoners, and the Pillory Scaffold is the showpiece. Deceit and Wrong share a torture theme, so the two pools split it: racks and blocks go to Wrong.

entries.why: Small orb web beaded with dew.
Empty chain and the bones beneath it.
Open coffin, lid gone, lining empty.
Hanging skeleton, one prisoner still in his boots.
Gibbet Row, two prisoners and an empty cage.
Pillory Scaffold, whipping post and onlookers' bench.
